propositions: A new `rebar attach-commits <ticket> <sha>...` verb validates SHAs and records COMMITS events across CLI, library, and MCP surfaces with all-or-nothing semantics.
The seam validation calls `commit_impact.invalid_commit_shas` before appending; any invalid SHA fails the entire batch and raises naming all offenders.

The close precheck performs a deterministic check comparing linked-commit paths against the union of `file_impact` across the ticket and transitive descendants, blocking if any path is undeclared and not exempted.
Merge commits are explicitly skipped from path inspection to avoid false passes from their empty diff representation.
Path matching uses `**/`-aware glob semantics (hoisted to a shared DET module with no `rebar.llm` import) and supports exact equality or directory-prefix matching.
Unreadable source-(ii) local commits fail the close check explicitly; unresolvable source-(i) remote SHAs are silently skipped to avoid false positives on incomplete clones.
